qwen_english.text: This is a test to see if I can speak in English.

chatterbox_proposals.text: This is Eduardo. This is a short test of my own voice.
Soy Eduardo. Esta es una prueba breve de mi voz en español.

chatterbox_preconditions: Approval for isolated image/dependency preparation and selective model download
Measured loader peak safely below existing preventive worker stop
Keep more than10GiB disk free for the accepted Qwen preflight
One serial agent queue and shared PVE lock; no concurrent heavy engine
Separate process must terminate completely on cancellation
Original reference mounted read-only; no copy or edit of the original
No reuse of Qwen acoustic checkpoints for Chatterbox
